page.layout: One block of italic verse in a single column, running from the top of the page to the foot; no margin notes. Below the text, centred, the signature "B 2". Faint show-through of the reverse page on the right is excluded.

l.i: Holdere, rursus hinc ego sic infero;
Doctrina quod si Vbiquitatis est noua,
Sequitur, quod illa ignota fuit Apostolis,
Et consequenter, dogma quòd ea est impium.
Sed est prius verum. Ergo posterius quoq[?].
Aut certè ego his intelligo omninò nihil,
Aut Nicodemus vestro honori consulit
Parùm, & meretur, illum vti vester Papa
Justissima ira accensus excommunicet,
Aut (quæ esset illi pœna adhùc acerbior)
Vt publico programmate affixo vetet
Eum popinas, aut tabernas ingredi,
In Lappiam curetúe deportarier
Miserū illū, aquā vt, dum vixerit, merā
bibat. Hæc ergò (vt iredeam, vnde abiui) situa[?]
Bœotica auri, Holdere, non nimis placent,
Veteris recorderis, rogo, prouerbij;
De re mala Sermo nequit fieri bonus.
Sin Nicodemus ille aliquid in posterum
Tuo Sagittarum arcui suggesserit,
Plumáue Cuculos discolori ornauerit,
Ipsi sciat cunctos poetas maximum
Juuante nobilitate bellum indicere,
Deformat ille quam suo more, & modo.

page.notes: Words marked [?] are doubtful: "quoq" (abbreviation mark unclear), "situa" (the last letter may be an abbreviation or a damaged letter), and "curetúe" is kept as printed with its accent. Several lines end with a printed hook or arrow mark, which is a line-end sign and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page on the right is not transcribed.
